name: Louise Murray
reason: Health restore, re-checked 12 Nov 2026: still out, now more clearly. Her site (www.healthblessings.com.au, Kiama NSW; robots.txt allows us) is mainly condition-led: the home page leads with testimonials of no pain within 24 hours of a broken back, a broken collarbone healed in an hour and depression gone after one session ('didn't need any more sessions'), and it offers 'Fertility and Babies' sessions. Her only workshop (Empowered Self-Healing & Conscious Health) teaches keto, carnivore and fasting ('let food be your medicine'; diet content is always out), calls artificial sweeteners neurotoxins, says fluoride is not a health supplement and links EMF exposure to infertility, cancer and chronic illness (health claims bordering on conspiracy content). Her only retreat (Thredbo, 12–15 March 2026) has passed. What would remain is generic energy-healing sessions on pages carrying those claims. Contact exists (louise@healthblessings.com.au).
